verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere markets itself as 'Private by default, offline by design' and a community member directly confirms 'Fully local - no data is collected,' addressing the telemetry question head-on. However, this is an architectural claim rather than an explicit telemetry-toggle/settings page, and the optional Wally Cloud path necessarily sends data off-device when used, with no documented opt-out control for cloud-side usage tracking. Missing for 10: an explicit telemetry settings/opt-out toggle in docs, and clarity on what usage data (if any) Wally Cloud collects/opts out of.
